summarise_text:
Summarise this in 3 bullet points:

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) was formed in 1969 and has since built a reputation for frugal engineering. Its Mars Orbiter Mission in 2013 reached Mars orbit on the first attempt at a cost often compared to that of a Hollywood film. Chandrayaan-3 landed near the lunar south pole in August 2023, making India the first country to do so. ISRO also runs a large commercial launch business through its PSLV rocket, which has carried hundreds of foreign satellites, and is now developing the Gaganyaan crewed spaceflight programme.
